name: Clara Inkwell
description: An investigative journalist who's been digging into corruption in Gearhaven. She knows more than she's published—because printing it would get her killed.

initial_greeting.text: Detective Cogsworth? I've been hoping you'd show up. I've been investigating the same conspiracy that got Steamwright killed. We should share information.

information_share.text: The Cog and Key controls everything—industry, politics, law enforcement. Steamwright discovered their plan to stage a political coup. I have names, dates, evidence. But I can't publish without corroboration. Help me expose them, and I'll help you solve the murder.

alliance.text: Together, we can take them down. Meet me at the docks tonight—I have more evidence hidden there. And Detective? Trust no one in uniform. The conspiracy runs deep.

rejected.text: Suit yourself. But when you realize how deep this goes, you'll wish you had an ally. My offer stands.
